variants.title: Fabry-Perot cavity with 90 % mirrors
variants.note: Lower reflectivity mirrors give wider peaks: the finesse falls to about 30. Everything else is as in the base experiment.

source.title: Illustrative design values
source.note: set by the lab for this condition; not taken from a named instrument's datasheet

variants.title: Fabry-Perot cavity with 99 % mirrors
variants.note: High reflectivity mirrors give very narrow peaks: the finesse is about 313 and the peak is a tenth of a volt wide on the scan.

source.title: Illustrative design values
source.note: set by the lab for this condition; not taken from a named instrument's datasheet
